siteSettings.heroSubtext: Exceptional Care for Exceptional Homes. Full-service property management, maintenance, housekeeping, estate services, and discreet domestic staffing for Hamptons homeowners.
siteSettings.servicesIntro: Every home in the Hamptons deserves thoughtful, professional care. Hamptons Spotless provides full-service property and estate management, overseeing everything from day-to-day housekeeping, maintenance, and seasonal preparation to exterior care, household staffing, domestic help recruitment, and estate clearing. Our services are tailored to each property and delivered with consistency, discretion, and attention to detail, whether you need ongoing management or support for a specific stage in your home’s lifecycle.
siteSettings.areasHeading: Every Detail Attended to.|Every Standard Met.
siteSettings.areasIntro: From Southampton to the shores of Montauk, we provide premium home services and household staff services across the Hamptons.
aboutParagraphs: Hamptons Spotless provides comprehensive property and estate management services throughout the East End. With 27 years of industry expertise, we care for Hamptons homes through full property management, housekeeping, maintenance, seasonal care, exterior services, household staffing, domestic help recruitment, estate clearing, and specialized property services.

We are more than a service company operating in the Hamptons. We are locally rooted and understand the unique demands of owning and maintaining a home here. Our approach is built around discretion, reliability, attention to detail, and a genuine understanding of the standards our clients expect.
trustPoints: Strong commitment to the local community

services.title: Property Management
services.description: Hamptons Spotless is a complete, end-to-end approach to property and estate care. Rather than coordinating multiple cleaning companies, contractors, housekeepers, maintenance providers, and property managers, our clients have one trusted team overseeing it all.

services.title: Full House Cleaning
services.description: Regular, seasonal, and deep cleaning services tailored to your home’s needs.

services.title: Move-In & Move-Out Cleaning
services.description: Detailed cleaning to ensure properties are presented in pristine condition.

services.title: Airbnb & Vacation Rentals
services.description: Professional turnover cleaning, ensuring every guest arrives to a spotless space.

services.title: Pre-Sale Preparation
services.description: Comprehensive presentation cleaning to ensure your property is showcased at its absolute best for viewings and market launch.

services.title: Exterior Maintenance
services.description: Specialist care for exterior surfaces, including window cleaning, soft washing, façades, patios, decking, and outdoor furnishings.

services.title: Estate Clearing
services.description: Professional and discreet clearing, sorting, removal, and coordination of household contents during estate transitions, downsizing, relocation, or property preparation.

services.title: Post-Construction Cleaning
services.description: Meticulous after-build cleaning that transforms newly completed or renovated properties from construction site to pristine, move-in ready condition.

services.title: Household Staffing
services.description: Discreet recruitment and placement of experienced private household staff, with thoroughly vetted candidates.

testimonials.quote: Professional, discreet, and genuinely caring about the work they do. They understand the standard we expect and deliver it every time.
